rules.name: Prompt injection vulnerability
rules.description: Exposing raw LLM system prompts directly to unvalidated user-controlled inputs allows manipulation of agent behavior.

rules.name: Excessive agency in tools configuration
rules.description: AI models should not be granted direct, autonomous, destructive capabilities without structural human-in-the-loop limits.

rules.name: Sensitive context disclosure
rules.description: Prompts or system parameters must not leak architecture, source code files, database schemas, or API keys to the model outputs.

rules.name: Improper output handling
rules.description: Model outputs must not be parsed and fed directly into executable contexts such as shell spawns, eval, or raw database parameters.

rules.name: Tool authorization bypass
rules.description: Tool actions requested by the AI model must undergo user session authorization check independently of the LLM context.
